verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a first-party 'Import your mail' help article and a 'Move from Gmail' guide. A community user confirms Fastmail has an easy migration tool, and another reports moving from Google services was easy. The evidence covers only the mail side, and only as article titles plus anecdotes; contact import is never mentioned. Missing for 10: documented contacts/address-book import, detail confirming complete history (all folders/labels) is imported, support for non-Gmail providers and desktop clients.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my complete mail history and contacts from my old provider or client

citations.quote: Fastmail has an easy migration tool if you don't want to go the IMAP route.
Was very pleasantly surprised how easy the move from Google services to Fastmail was
